subject: maths
question: Sohan alone can do a work in 18 days and Mohan alone can do the same work in 36 days. In how many days will they together complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

Sohan alone can do a work in 18 days.

Mohan alone can do the same work in 36 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done together in 1 day = (1)/({Sohan's time)} + (1)/({Mohan's time)}

Total time to complete work together = (1)/({Work done together in 1 day)}

**Calculation:**

Work done by Sohan in 1 day = 1/18

Work done by Mohan in 1 day = 1/36

Work done together in 1 day = (1)/(18) + (1)/(36)

Work done together in 1 day = (2)/(36) + (1)/(36)

Work done together in 1 day = (3)/(36)

Work done together in 1 day = 1/12

Total time to complete work together = (1)/(( frac{1){12} )}

Total time to complete work together = 12 days

**The correct answer is option 1: 12 days.**
